svg.text: WALKASSIST wiring: Nano 33 IoT on a mini breadboard
Each Nano pin's row: 3 free holes on the left, 2 on the right. Row 16 (bottom) is free. Check the pin names printed on your Nano match.
Everything runs at 3.3 V; the 9 V battery goes only to VIN. Dashed = assembly soldered off the breadboard.
on top of the handle; wires in
2N4401, flat side facing you: legs E-B-C
Pins used (D2 is free now that the FSR replaced the touch board)
buzzer (1 kΩ) / LED R / G / B (220 Ω)
